name: dutch-cultural-heritage-collections
description: Dutch cultural heritage collections: search and read digitised Dutch heritage sources. Services: Delpher (Koninklijke Bibliotheek) for newspapers, magazines, books and ANP radio bulletins; the person indexes of the Amsterdam City Archives, including the personal and archive cards 1939-1994; person records and archive search links for the Rotterdam City Archives and the Noord-Hollands Archief; and the archives of the NIOD Institute for War, Holocaust and Genocide Studies via EHRI.
